summary: Discover the power of data with our Power BI training. Focus on Data Analysis & Reporting to enhance your analytical capabilities and decision-making.
lede: Data Analysis & Reporting using Power BI teaches you to turn raw data into actionable insights with PowerPivot and Power BI. You will explore more effective ways to analyze information across functions such as finance, marketing, and human resources, while moving beyond traditional Excel capabilities. Learn to use DAX formulas to build data models and KPIs, then create dynamic dashboards, visualizations, and business intelligence reports. The course also helps you share insights across your organization to support stronger decision-making and operational efficiency.
audienceIntro: This course is ideal for professionals who seek to elevate their data analysis skills using Power BI.
modules: PART 1: Working with classic Pivot Tables
PART 2: First practical example of Power Pivot (only Excel 2013 Professional Plus)
PART 3: Starting with the infrastructure to build a dash board using Power Pivot from scratch
PART 4: Building the Dashboard in PowerPivot from scratch step by step
PART 5: Very important notes in building dashboards using DAX
prerequisites: BI Skills are not required for this course. You just need to have a workable knowledge in Excel to master all contents of this very intensive course. You need to bring your Laptop with Excel 2010 (any edition) or Excel 2013/16 (professional plus). Excel 2016 professional plus is preferred for many reasons. Excel 2007 is not allowed at all.
